sources.derived_summary: Twelve human participants; participant-specific imputation; 250 Hz, 4-second windows; first six days training and seventh evaluation. Published endpoints include channelwise correlation, spectral comparisons and rest/movement random-forest classification. Dropout rates are 50%, 70%, 90%, with five masks each. Mean imputation and a learned deterministic imputer are comparators. PSD similarity alone does not establish samplewise fidelity. Exact figure reproduction and deterministic model execution remain held.

Read events/channels/time from processed participant NetCDF, exclude final label channel; inclusive [-2,2] selection; last sorted unique event-day held out. Labels subtract one. Per-channel training ranges determine 25/75 percentile fences extended by five IQRs; zero ranges and strict outside-fence ranges are invalid. All training ranges enter percentile fitting. Repeat quality masks across time. Masked training mean/population standard deviation over event and time axes standardize both partitions. Last-day code differs from fixed first-six/seventh prose when metadata has fewer/more days. Code assertion mistakenly checks train shape twice; prospective implementation must validate actual test shape.

Observed channel count uses NumPy rounding of (1-dropout)*C and default_rng(seed).choice without replacement. Same channel mask applies to every held-out event. Conditioning concatenates mask and mask*signal; predicted hidden values are joined with observed values, then unstandardized. Mean imputation fills training means. Three random-forest fits on training subsets evaluate the same held-out samples; fold training permutation uses mask_seed, RF randomness uses rf_seed+fold. Function does not read dataset quality masks. Returned endpoints are average classification accuracies, not MSE or a scalar PSD error.
Default EC07; 1001 samples; +/-2 seconds; conditional training; 25/75 percentiles and IQR factor five. EC07 is a configuration default, not the full population.
Author script enumerates all twelve participants and participant-specific channel counts. It is a training script, not evidence that training or evaluation ran.

Spectral plots call scipy.signal.csd(signal,signal) with supplied sampling frequency and segment length, then aggregate medians/quantiles. A fixed FFT-periodogram scalar discrepancy must be labeled a prospective scoring policy rather than historical figure reproduction.

requirements_mapping.requirement: Complete selected human processed ECoG population
requirements_mapping.recommendation: Declare full EC01–EC12 roster and all event rows. An EC07 engineering example must not imply full-panel completion.
Fit mean/std and IQR fences from training only. Training target channels may be used; held-out targets cannot influence fitting or candidate-facing inputs.
Identical immutable observed sets and complete retrospective windows across candidate, mean, and train-only conditional baseline. Never advertise online forecasting.

Prospectively freeze target-only standardized/raw MSE and explicit spectral discrepancy. Declare aggregation and unit scaling. Report counts of complete and quality-eligible targets. Published RF/correlation/PSD comparisons remain distinct.

requirements_mapping.requirement: Human participant/session and blocked time guards
requirements_mapping.recommendation: Use explicit event-day-disjoint split, preserve all days. Guard-band/overlap certification remains held without absolute event supports; relative [-2,2] time grid cannot supply that proof.
Generated controls prove algebra/interface behavior only. Native data, diffusion training, learned deterministic baseline, published RF reproduction and feasibility remain held.
